headline: US and Canada Negotiate Lower Steel and Auto Tariffs to Ease Trade Tensions
summary: Washington and Ottawa are holding bilateral talks to reduce U.S. import tariffs on Canadian automotive components and steel products. The discussions aim to de-escalate cross-border trade friction following earlier retaliatory tariffs.
why: Cross-border tariffs between the U.S. and Canada directly affect North American supply chains, industrial manufacturing costs, and bilateral trade volumes.
